notes.title: Update 2025 05 08
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - The Prison[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Localized Dialogues on Every Zone:[/b] Added contextual NPC dialogues in both English and Spanish for every prison zone and job type.
[*][b]Completely Revamped Progression System:[/b] XP, Health, Action Points, and Action progression redesigned for deeper gameplay.
[*][b]New Shops and Loot Rewards:[/b] All prison zones now feature unique shops, special loot drops, and balanced level grinding for high-level players.
[*][b]20 New Weapons:[/b] Added 20 new weapons, available through combat or purchase. Enemies feature unique drop rates.
[*][b]Consumables Now Restore Action Points:[/b] Introducing AP-based consumables to encourage strategic planning in combat.
[*][b]New Character Creator:[/b] Customize characters more than ever with reworked faces and enhanced in-game representation.
[*][b]New NPC Creator:[/b] NPCs now appear more varied with expanded customization options.
[*][b]7 New Quests:[/b] New missions push the story forward and expand the prison’s narrative content.
[*][b]NPCs Up to Level 90:[/b] NPC level range extended for expanded progression across the prison.
[*][b]Upgraded Attack Animations:[/b] Improved animations for heavy object and bare-hand attacks.
[*][b]New Inventory Item Visor:[/b] Items now display in a dynamic visor with size and shape previews.
[*][b]Faction System Introduced:[/b] Create groups with friends and access exclusive chat channels. More faction features coming soon.
[*][b][WiP] Skills-Based Progression:[/b] Current base attributes will be replaced by a passive/active skill system in future updates.
[*][b][WiP] Onboarding & Tutorial:[/b] A new tutorial and onboarding process is being tested.
[*][b][WiP] Ranked Battles:[/b] A new zone dedicated to ranked combat is in development.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Item Tooltip Improvements:[/b] Tooltips now show more detailed and useful information.
[*][b]Weapons Rebalanced:[/b] Damage, prices, and action point costs adjusted for better progression.
[*][b]Consumables Rebalanced:[/b] Improved healing amounts and prices for better gameplay flow.
[*][b]New Fonts and Typography:[/b] Font assets updated for a more polished visual experience.
[*][b]Improved NPC Shadows:[/b] Shadows are now more consistent and less ghost-like.
[*][b]Mesh & Lighting Updates:[/b] Multiple mesh and lighting updates across all prison zones.
[*][b]Dialogue Visor Improvements:[/b] Better character representation and larger UI.
[*][b]Loot Pricing Fixes:[/b] Looted items now sell at their correct base price.
[*][b][WiP] Quest System Stability:[/b] Ongoing improvements to quest system stability.
[*][b]Point & Click Visual Style:[/b] Point & Click now features a monitor-style visual interface.
[*][b]New NPC Animations:[/b] Expanded animation sets for immersive NPC interactions.
[*][b]Improved AI Behaviour:[/b] NPCs now perform a wider range of autonomous tasks.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Knife Special Animations Fix:[/b] Fixed glitches with special knife animations.
[*][b]Bare Hands Attack Damage Fix:[/b] Resolved inconsistencies in unarmed attack damage.
[*][b]Crash When Opening Item Without Mesh Fixed:[/b] Prevented crash when accessing items missing 3D assets.
[*][b]Combat Crash Fix:[/b] Addressed game crashes triggered during combat.
[*][b]Hotfix for Administration Stores:[/b] Inventory issues in admin stores resolved.
[*][b]Boxing NPC Pair Animation Fix:[/b] Fixed issues with NPCs boxing in pairs.
[*][b]Warning & Typo Fixes:[/b] Cleaned up code warnings and corrected UI/category typos.
[*][b]Linux Quest Completion Crash Fix:[/b] Resolved a UE 5.5 crash on Linux systems triggered during quest completion.
[*][b]Objective Completion Disconnect Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that disconnected clients from the server upon objective completion.
[*][b]OverlapActor Crash Fix:[/b] Fixed crash caused by player overlapping a volume.
[/list]

notes.title: Rollback Hofix
notes.content:
[h1]Rollback Hotfix - The Prison[/h1]

Due to unforeseen issues affecting gameplay stability, we have rolled back recent updates to ensure a smooth experience for all players. The rollback includes reversing changes related to the Factions System, character creator facial manipulation features, item balance adjustments, and inventory updates.

[h2]Rollback Details[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Factions System Rollback:[/b] Work-in-progress features for the Factions System have been removed to prevent interruptions during gameplay.
[*][b]Character Creator Features Reverted:[/b] Recent facial manipulation enhancements in the character creator have been rolled back to ensure character customization operates as expected.
[*][b]Item Balance Restored:[/b] Item stats, including weapon damage and consumable pricing, have been reverted to previous settings to maintain gameplay balance.
[*][b]Administration Store Inventory Reset:[/b] Updated items in Administration stores have been reset to their previous state for consistency.
[/list]

We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve these issues. Please stay tuned for future updates, and thank you for your continued support of The Prison.
